**Dr. Eric Payton is the Principal Investigator for the Critical Alloy Research & Discovery Laboratory at the University of Cincinnati.**

Dr. Payton’s laboratory addresses the sustainability of critical materials through fundamental research into alloy design, discovery, and processing, enabling design engineers to balance performance with responsible resource utilization. Employing state-of-the-art computational and quantitative characterization techniques, his group seeks to lend insights into microstructure evolution during processing and chemo-mechanical environmental interactions in service, then use this knowledge to develop practical tools for predicting material properties. Prior to joining the faculty of the University of Cincinnati in 2022, Dr. Payton served for five years as the Research Leader for the Metallic Materials and Processing Team at the Air Force Research Laboratory, Materials and Manufacturing Directorate. Before entering government service, he was an Assistant Professor of Materials Science and Engineering at the New York State College of Ceramics at Alfred University, and held post-doctoral positions at both Ruhr University in Bochum, Germany and the Federal Institute for Materials Research and Testing (BAM) in Berlin, Germany. He obtained his doctorate in Materials Science and Engineering from The Ohio State University. Dr. Payton’s colleagues suspect he would be a good addition to their trivia night team; however, his area of trivia mastery may be limited to turn-of-the century musicians. Dr. Payton is an enthusiastic advocate of scientific collaboration, structured programming, learner-centered pedagogy, and vegetables.

```{python}
def parse_date(text):
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
        return None
    text = text.strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    season = re.match(r"(spring|summer|fall|autumn|winter)\s+(\d{4})", text, flags=re.I)
    if season:
        season_map = {"spring": "03-01", "summer": "06-01", "fall": "09-01", "autumn": "09-01", "winter": "12-01"}
        return dt.date.fromisoformat(f"{season.group(2)}-{season_map[season.group(1).lower()]}")
    if re.match(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", text):
        try:
            return dt.date.fromisoformat(text[:10])
        except Exception:
            return None
    if re.match(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}$", text):
        try:
            return dt.date.fromisoformat(f"{text}-01")
        except Exception:
            return None
    if re.match(r"^\d{4}$", text):
        try:
            return dt.date.fromisoformat(f"{text}-01-01")
        except Exception:
            return None
    try:
        return dt.datetime.fromisoformat(text).date()
    except Exception:
        return None


def extract_year(text):
    d = parse_date(text)
    return d.year if d else None


def date_parts_to_iso(date_parts):
    if not isinstance(date_parts, list) or not date_parts or not isinstance(date_parts[0], list):
        return ""
    p = date_parts[0]
    try:
        y = int(p[0]) if len(p) > 0 and p[0] not in (None, "") else 0
        m = int(p[1]) if len(p) > 1 and p[1] not in (None, "") else 1
        d = int(p[2]) if len(p) > 2 and p[2] not in (None, "") else 1
    except Exception:
        return ""
    if y <= 0:
        return ""
    return f"{y:04d}-{m:02d}-{d:02d}"


def normalize_csl_people(csl_people, creator_type):
    if not isinstance(csl_people, list):
        return []
    out = []
    for p in csl_people:
        out.append(
            {
                "creatorType": creator_type,
                "firstName": (p.get("given") or "").strip() if isinstance(p, dict) else "",
                "lastName": (p.get("family") or "").strip() if isinstance(p, dict) else "",
                "name": (str(p.get("literal") or "").strip() if isinstance(p, dict) else ""),
            }
        )
    return out


def map_csl_type_to_zotero(type_name):
    key = (type_name or "").lower()
    mapping = {
        "article-journal": "journalArticle",
        "article-magazine": "magazineArticle",
        "paper-conference": "conferencePaper",
        "speech": "presentation",
        "thesis": "thesis",
        "report": "report",
        "book": "book",
        "chapter": "bookSection",
    }
    return mapping.get(key, "document")


def normalize_pre_uc_item(item):
    creators = []
    creators.extend(normalize_csl_people(item.get("author"), "author"))
    creators.extend(normalize_csl_people(item.get("contributor"), "contributor"))
    creators.extend(normalize_csl_people(item.get("editor"), "editor"))
    issued = item.get("issued") or {}
    date_parts = (
        issued.get("date-parts")
        or issued.get("dateParts")
        or issued.get("dateparts")
        or issued
    )
    return {
        "key": item.get("id") or item.get("citation-key") or "",
        "data": {
            "librarySource": "pre-uc",
            "itemType": map_csl_type_to_zotero(item.get("type")),
            "title": item.get("title") or "",
            "creators": creators,
            "date": date_parts_to_iso(date_parts) or "",
            "abstractNote": item.get("abstract") or item.get("abstractNote") or "",
            "keywords": item.get("keyword") or [],
            "publicationTitle": item.get("container-title") or "",
            "proceedingsTitle": item.get("container-title") or "",
            "meetingName": item.get("event-title") or "",
            "publisher": item.get("publisher") or "",
            "place": item.get("publisher-place") or "",
            "volume": item.get("volume") or "",
            "issue": item.get("issue") or "",
            "pages": item.get("page") or "",
            "reportType": item.get("genre") or "",
            "reportNumber": item.get("number") or "",
            "url": item.get("URL") or "",
            "DOI": item.get("DOI") or "",
        },
    }


def normalize_doi(text):
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    return re.sub(r"^https?://(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/", "", text.strip(), flags=re.I).lower()


def dedupe_items(items):
    out = []
    by_key = {}

    def _is_empty(v):
        if v is None:
            return True
        if isinstance(v, str):
            return not v.strip()
        if isinstance(v, (list, tuple, dict, set)):
            return len(v) == 0
        return False

    for item in items:
        data = item.get("data") or {}
        doi_key = normalize_doi(data.get("DOI", ""))
        source = str(data.get("librarySource") or "zotero").strip().lower()
        item_type = str(data.get("itemType") or "").strip()
        is_pre_uc_conference_presentation = source == "pre-uc" and item_type == "conferencePaper"
        is_presentation_like = item_type == "presentation" or bool(data.get("presentationType")) or is_pre_uc_conference_presentation
        item_key = str(item.get("key") or data.get("key") or data.get("citationKey") or data.get("citation-key") or "").strip()
        if doi_key:
            key = f"doi-pres::{doi_key}" if is_presentation_like else f"doi::{doi_key}"
        elif item_key:
            key = f"id::{source}::{item_key.lower()}"
        else:
            key = "raw::" + "||".join(
                [
                    source,
                    (data.get("itemType") or "").strip().lower(),
                    (data.get("title") or "").strip().lower(),
                    str(data.get("date") or "").strip(),
                    (data.get("meetingName") or "").strip().lower(),
                    (data.get("proceedingsTitle") or "").strip().lower(),
                    (data.get("url") or "").strip().lower(),
                ]
            )
        if not key:
            continue
        if key not in by_key:
            clone = dict(item)
            clone["data"] = dict(data)
            by_key[key] = clone
            out.append(clone)
            continue

        existing = by_key[key].get("data") or {}

        # Preserve pre-UC provenance when a Zotero item and a pre-UC item collapse to one record.
        existing_source = str(existing.get("librarySource") or "").strip().lower()
        incoming_source = str(data.get("librarySource") or "").strip().lower()
        if incoming_source == "pre-uc" and existing_source != "pre-uc":
            existing["librarySource"] = "pre-uc"

        for field, value in data.items():
            if _is_empty(existing.get(field)) and not _is_empty(value):
                existing[field] = value
    return out


def creator_name(c):
    if not isinstance(c, dict):
        return ""
    if c.get("name"):
        return str(c["name"]).strip()
    return f"{str(c.get('firstName') or '').strip()} {str(c.get('lastName') or '').strip()}".strip()


def has_payton_author(item):
    creators = item.get("data", {}).get("creators") or []
    for a in creators:
        last = str(a.get("lastName") or "").strip().lower()
        full = creator_name(a).lower()
        if last == "payton" or re.search(r"\bpayton\b", full):
            return True
    return False


def is_presentation_record(item):
    d = item.get("data") or {}
    item_type = str(d.get("itemType") or "").strip()
    source = str(d.get("librarySource") or "").strip().lower()
    is_pre_uc_conference_presentation = source == "pre-uc" and item_type == "conferencePaper"
    return item_type == "presentation" or bool(d.get("presentationType")) or is_pre_uc_conference_presentation


def top_collaborators(items, n=10):
    counts = Counter()
    label_votes = defaultdict(Counter)

    def _initial_tokens(text):
        return re.findall(r"[A-Za-z]+", str(text or ""))

    def _literal_parts(literal):
        literal = str(literal or "").strip()
        if not literal:
            return [], ""
        if "," in literal:
            surname, given = [p.strip() for p in literal.split(",", 1)]
            return _initial_tokens(given), surname
        parts = re.split(r"\s+", literal)
        if len(parts) == 1:
            return [], parts[0]
        return _initial_tokens(" ".join(parts[:-1])), parts[-1]

    def _canonical_collaborator(creator):
        first = str(creator.get("firstName") or "").strip()
        last = str(creator.get("lastName") or "").strip()
        if first and last:
            return f"{first[0].upper()}. {last}"

        initials, surname = _literal_parts(creator.get("name"))
        if initials and surname:
            return f"{initials[0][0].upper()}. {surname}"
        return surname

    def _display_collaborator(creator):
        first = str(creator.get("firstName") or "").strip()
        last = str(creator.get("lastName") or "").strip()
        if first and last:
            tokens = _initial_tokens(first)
            if tokens:
                initials = " ".join(f"{t[0].upper()}." for t in tokens)
                return f"{initials} {last}"
            return f"{first[0].upper()}. {last}"

        initials, surname = _literal_parts(creator.get("name"))
        if initials and surname:
            joined = " ".join(f"{t[0].upper()}." for t in initials)
            return f"{joined} {surname}"
        return surname

    def _is_pi(creator):
        last = str(creator.get("lastName") or "").strip().lower()
        if last == "payton":
            return True
        full = creator_name(creator).lower()
        return bool(re.search(r"\bpayton\b", full))

    for item in items:
        authors = [x for x in (item.get("data", {}).get("creators") or []) if x.get("creatorType") == "author"]
        unique_this_paper = set()
        for a in authors:
            name = _canonical_collaborator(a)
            if not name or _is_pi(a):
                continue
            key = name.lower()
            if key in unique_this_paper:
                continue
            unique_this_paper.add(key)
            counts[key] += 1
            display_name = _display_collaborator(a) or name
            label_votes[key][display_name] += 1

    resolved = []
    for key, count in counts.items():
        labels = label_votes.get(key) or Counter()
        best_label = sorted(labels.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0].lower()))[0][0] if labels else key
        resolved.append((best_label, count, key))

    ranked = sorted(resolved, key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[2]))
    ranked = [(label, count) for label, count, _ in ranked]
    if len(ranked) <= n:
        return ranked
    threshold = ranked[n - 1][1]
    return [row for row in ranked if row[1] >= threshold]


def word_frequency(items, n=18):
    stop_words = {
        "about", "after", "all", "also", "and", "are", "been", "between", "but", "can", "from", "for",
        "into", "its", "not", "of", "on", "or", "our", "such", "than", "that", "the", "their",
        "there", "these", "this", "those", "through", "using", "via", "was", "were", "with", "within",
        "without", "study", "effect", "effects", "analysis", "investigation", "properties", "property",
        "alloy", "alloys", "material", "materials", "microstructure", "microstructures",
        "based", "toward", "towards", "during", "characterization", "mechanical", "behavior",
        "model", "models", "modeling", "approach", "approaches", "processing", "phase",
        "high", "low", "new", "novel", "using", "through", "toward", "results", "result",
        "two", "used", "due", "use", "uses", "utilized", "utilize",
    }
    low_uniqueness_words = {
        "two", "used", "due", "use", "uses", "utilized", "utilize",
    }
    raw_counts = Counter()

    def _tag_text(tags):
        if not isinstance(tags, list):
            return ""
        out = []
        for t in tags:
            if isinstance(t, dict):
                val = str(t.get("tag") or "").strip()
            else:
                val = str(t).strip()
            if val:
                out.append(val)
        return " ".join(out)

    def _keyword_text(val):
        if isinstance(val, list):
            return " ".join(str(x).strip() for x in val if str(x).strip())
        return str(val or "")

    def _canonical_word(word, vocabulary):
        if word.endswith("ies") and len(word) > 4:
            candidate = word[:-3] + "y"
            if candidate in vocabulary:
                return candidate
        if word.endswith("s") and len(word) > 3 and not word.endswith(("ss", "us", "is")):
            candidate = word[:-1]
            if candidate in vocabulary:
                return candidate
        return word

    for item in items:
        d = item.get("data", {})
        blob = " ".join(
            [
                str(d.get("title") or ""),
                str(d.get("abstractNote") or d.get("abstract") or ""),
                _tag_text(d.get("tags")),
                _keyword_text(d.get("keywords")),
            ]
        ).lower()
        words = re.findall(r"[a-z]{3,}", blob)
        for w in words:
            raw_counts[w] += 1

    vocabulary = set(raw_counts)
    counts = Counter()
    for word, count in raw_counts.items():
        canonical = _canonical_word(word, vocabulary)
        if canonical in stop_words or canonical in low_uniqueness_words:
            continue
        counts[canonical] += count
    return counts.most_common(n)


def load_json_candidates(candidates):
    for candidate in candidates:
        p = Path(candidate)
        if p.exists():
            with p.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Could not find any of: {candidates}")


def _openalex_budget_exhausted(payload):
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return False
    message = " ".join(
        [
            str(payload.get("message") or ""),
            str(payload.get("error") or ""),
        ]
    ).lower()
    return "insufficient budget" in message or "dailyremainingusd" in message


def fetch_openalex_for_doi(doi, request_timeout=8, max_attempts=3, budget_state=None):
    doi = normalize_doi(doi)
    if not doi:
        return None
    params = {
        "filter": f"doi:{doi}",
        "select": "doi,cited_by_count,counts_by_year,publication_year,open_access,best_oa_location",
        "per-page": 1,
        "mailto": "paytonej@ucmail.uc.edu",
    }
    q = "https://api.openalex.org/works?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params, quote_via=urllib.parse.quote)
    headers = {
        "User-Agent": "CARD Lab scientometrics (mailto:paytonej@ucmail.uc.edu)",
        "From": "paytonej@ucmail.uc.edu",
        "Accept": "application/json",
    }

    for attempt in range(max_attempts):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(q, headers=headers)
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=request_timeout) as resp:
                if resp.status != 200:
                    continue
                payload = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
                if _openalex_budget_exhausted(payload):
                    if isinstance(budget_state, dict):
                        budget_state["exhausted"] = True
                    return None
                rows = payload.get("results") or []
                if not rows:
                    return None
                row = dict(rows[0])
                # Keep the queried DOI for robust downstream joins when API DOI fields are sparse.
                row["_query_doi"] = doi
                return row
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
            try:
                body = err.read().decode("utf-8")
                payload = json.loads(body)
                if _openalex_budget_exhausted(payload) and isinstance(budget_state, dict):
                    budget_state["exhausted"] = True
            except Exception:
                pass
            if err.code in (408, 409, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504) and attempt < (max_attempts - 1):
                time.sleep(0.8 + (attempt * 1.1))
                continue
            return None
        except Exception:
            if attempt < (max_attempts - 1):
                time.sleep(0.6 + (attempt * 0.9))
                continue
            return None
    return None


def fetch_openalex_work_endpoint(doi, request_timeout=8, max_attempts=2, budget_state=None):
    doi = normalize_doi(doi)
    if not doi:
        return None
    url = "https://api.openalex.org/works/https://doi.org/" + urllib.parse.quote(doi, safe="")
    headers = {
        "User-Agent": "CARD Lab scientometrics (mailto:paytonej@ucmail.uc.edu)",
        "From": "paytonej@ucmail.uc.edu",
        "Accept": "application/json",
    }
    for attempt in range(max_attempts):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=request_timeout) as resp:
                if resp.status != 200:
                    continue
                row = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
                if _openalex_budget_exhausted(row):
                    if isinstance(budget_state, dict):
                        budget_state["exhausted"] = True
                    return None
                if not isinstance(row, dict):
                    return None
                row["_query_doi"] = doi
                return row
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
            try:
                body = err.read().decode("utf-8")
                payload = json.loads(body)
                if _openalex_budget_exhausted(payload) and isinstance(budget_state, dict):
                    budget_state["exhausted"] = True
            except Exception:
                pass
            if err.code in (408, 409, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504) and attempt < (max_attempts - 1):
                time.sleep(0.8 + attempt)
                continue
            return None
        except Exception:
            if attempt < (max_attempts - 1):
                time.sleep(0.6 + attempt)
                continue
            return None
    return None


def fetch_all_profiles(dois, max_doi=120, total_time_budget_sec=130):
    unique = []
    seen = set()
    for d in dois:
        nd = normalize_doi(d)
        if nd and nd not in seen:
            seen.add(nd)
            unique.append(nd)
    selected = unique[:max_doi]
    out = []
    citation_by_doi = {}
    profile_by_doi = {}

    cache_candidates = [Path("../files/references_citing_pi.csv"), Path("files/references_citing_pi.csv")]
    cache_path = cache_candidates[0] if cache_candidates[0].parent.exists() else cache_candidates[1]
    start_ts = time.monotonic()
    budget_state = {"exhausted": False}

    def _time_budget_exceeded():
        return (time.monotonic() - start_ts) >= float(total_time_budget_sec)

    def _load_cache(path):
        if not path.exists():
            return {}
        loaded = {}
        try:
            with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
                reader = csv.DictReader(f)
                for row in reader:
                    row_type = str(row.get("row_type") or "").strip().lower()
                    has_cache_payload = bool(
                        str(row.get("cited_by_count") or "").strip()
                        or str(row.get("counts_by_year_json") or "").strip()
                        or str(row.get("open_access_json") or "").strip()
                    )
                    if row_type and row_type != "cache":
                        continue
                    if (not row_type) and (not has_cache_payload):
                        continue
                    doi = normalize_doi(row.get("doi") or "")
                    if not doi:
                        doi = normalize_doi(row.get("ref_doi") or row.get("cited_doi") or "")
                    if not doi:
                        continue
                    try:
                        counts_by_year = json.loads(row.get("counts_by_year_json") or "[]")
                    except Exception:
                        counts_by_year = []
                    try:
                        open_access = json.loads(row.get("open_access_json") or "{}")
                    except Exception:
                        open_access = {}
                    try:
                        best_oa_location = json.loads(row.get("best_oa_location_json") or "{}")
                    except Exception:
                        best_oa_location = {}
                    loaded[doi] = {
                        "doi": doi,
                        "_query_doi": doi,
                        "cited_by_count": int(row.get("cited_by_count") or 0),
                        "publication_year": int(row.get("publication_year") or 0) or None,
                        "counts_by_year": counts_by_year if isinstance(counts_by_year, list) else [],
                        "open_access": open_access if isinstance(open_access, dict) else {},
                        "best_oa_location": best_oa_location if isinstance(best_oa_location, dict) else {},
                        "_cache_updated_utc": row.get("updated_utc") or "",
                    }
        except Exception:
            return {}
        return loaded

    cache_records = _load_cache(cache_path)

    def _fetch_openalex_batch(chunk):
        if budget_state.get("exhausted"):
            return []
        filter_expr = "doi:" + "|".join(chunk)
        params = {
            "filter": filter_expr,
            "select": "doi,cited_by_count,counts_by_year,publication_year,open_access,best_oa_location",
            "per-page": len(chunk),
            "mailto": "paytonej@ucmail.uc.edu",
        }
        q = "https://api.openalex.org/works?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params, quote_via=urllib.parse.quote)
        headers = {
            "User-Agent": "CARD Lab scientometrics (mailto:paytonej@ucmail.uc.edu)",
            "From": "paytonej@ucmail.uc.edu",
            "Accept": "application/json",
        }
        for attempt in range(3):
            try:
                if _time_budget_exceeded():
                    return []
                req = urllib.request.Request(q, headers=headers)
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
                    if resp.status != 200:
                        continue
                    payload = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
                    if _openalex_budget_exhausted(payload):
                        budget_state["exhausted"] = True
                        return []
                    return payload.get("results") or []
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
                try:
                    body = err.read().decode("utf-8")
                    payload = json.loads(body)
                    if _openalex_budget_exhausted(payload):
                        budget_state["exhausted"] = True
                        return []
                except Exception:
                    pass
                if err.code in (408, 409, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504) and attempt < 2:
                    time.sleep(0.9 + (attempt * 1.2))
                    continue
                return []
            except Exception:
                if attempt < 2:
                    time.sleep(0.7 + (attempt * 0.9))
                    continue
                return []
        return []

    for i in range(0, len(selected), 25):
        if _time_budget_exceeded() or budget_state.get("exhausted"):
            break
        chunk = selected[i : i + 25]
        chunk_set = set(chunk)
        matched = set()
        for row in _fetch_openalex_batch(chunk):
            nd = normalize_doi(str(row.get("doi") or ""))
            if not nd or nd not in chunk_set:
                continue
            rec = dict(row)
            rec["_query_doi"] = nd
            profile_by_doi[nd] = rec
            citation_by_doi[nd] = int(rec.get("cited_by_count") or 0)
            matched.add(nd)

        # Fall back to single DOI requests for unresolved rows in the chunk.
        unresolved = [d for d in chunk if d not in matched]
        for doi in unresolved:
            if _time_budget_exceeded() or budget_state.get("exhausted"):
                break
            row = fetch_openalex_for_doi(doi, request_timeout=8, max_attempts=2, budget_state=budget_state)
            if not row:
                row = fetch_openalex_work_endpoint(doi, request_timeout=8, max_attempts=2, budget_state=budget_state)
            if row:
                profile_by_doi[doi] = row
                citation_by_doi[doi] = int(row.get("cited_by_count") or 0)
            time.sleep(0.15)

    # Cache fallback for unresolved DOIs when OpenAlex is unavailable or rate limited.
    for doi in selected:
        if doi in profile_by_doi:
            continue
        cached = cache_records.get(doi)
        if cached:
            profile_by_doi[doi] = cached
            citation_by_doi[doi] = int(cached.get("cited_by_count") or 0)

    # Update in-memory cache with newest successful profile rows.
    for doi, rec in profile_by_doi.items():
        cache_records[doi] = {
            "doi": doi,
            "cited_by_count": int(rec.get("cited_by_count") or 0),
            "publication_year": rec.get("publication_year"),
            "counts_by_year": rec.get("counts_by_year") or [],
            "open_access": rec.get("open_access") or {},
            "best_oa_location": rec.get("best_oa_location") or {},
        }

    out = list(profile_by_doi.values())

    return out, citation_by_doi, len(selected), len(unique) > max_doi, cache_records, bool(budget_state.get("exhausted"))


def cumulative_series(profiles, start_year=None, end_year=None):
    year_counts = defaultdict(int)
    for p in profiles:
        for row in p.get("counts_by_year") or []:
            y = row.get("year")
            c = row.get("cited_by_count") or 0
            if isinstance(y, int):
                year_counts[y] += int(c)

    if not year_counts:
        return []

    min_year = min(year_counts.keys()) if start_year is None else int(start_year)
    max_year = max(year_counts.keys()) if end_year is None else int(end_year)
    if max_year < min_year:
        min_year, max_year = max_year, min_year

    years = list(range(min_year, max_year + 1))
    cumulative = 0
    result = []
    for y in years:
        cumulative += year_counts.get(y, 0)
        result.append((y, cumulative))
    return result


def h_index(citation_counts):
    arr = sorted([int(x) for x in citation_counts if isinstance(x, (int, float))], reverse=True)
    h = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(arr, start=1):
        if c >= i:
            h = i
        else:
            break
    return h


def g_index(citation_counts):
    arr = sorted([int(x) for x in citation_counts if isinstance(x, (int, float))], reverse=True)
    g = 0
    running = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(arr, start=1):
        running += c
        if running >= (i * i):
            g = i
        else:
            break
    return g


def make_value_box(label, value, icon, theme):
    return (
        f"<div class='value-box {theme}'>"
        f"<div class='top-row'><div class='label'>{escape(label)}</div><iconify-icon icon='{escape(icon)}'></iconify-icon></div>"
        f"<div class='value'>{escape(value)}</div>"
        "</div>"
    )


def cumulative_chart_svg(series, width=980, height=340):
    if not series:
        return "<p>No citation time-series data available.</p>"
    pad_l, pad_r, pad_t, pad_b = 56, 20, 18, 36
    plot_w = width - pad_l - pad_r
    plot_h = height - pad_t - pad_b
    xs = [x for x, _ in series]
    ys = [y for _, y in series]
    min_x, max_x = min(xs), max(xs)
    max_y = max(max(ys), 1)

    def sx(x):
        if max_x == min_x:
            return pad_l + plot_w / 2
        return pad_l + ((x - min_x) / (max_x - min_x)) * plot_w

    def sy(y):
        return pad_t + plot_h - (y / max_y) * plot_h

    poly = " ".join(f"{sx(x):.2f},{sy(y):.2f}" for x, y in series)
    x_ticks = sorted({min_x, int((min_x + max_x) / 2), max_x})
    y_ticks = [int(round((i / 4) * max_y)) for i in range(5)]

    parts = [
        f"<svg viewBox='0 0 {width} {height}' width='100%' role='img' aria-label='Cumulative citations over time'>",
        "<rect x='0' y='0' width='100%' height='100%' fill='white'/>",
        f"<line x1='{pad_l}' y1='{pad_t+plot_h}' x2='{pad_l+plot_w}' y2='{pad_t+plot_h}' stroke='#d9e1ea'/>",
        f"<line x1='{pad_l}' y1='{pad_t}' x2='{pad_l}' y2='{pad_t+plot_h}' stroke='#d9e1ea'/>",
    ]
    for v in y_ticks:
        y = sy(v)
        parts.append(f"<line x1='{pad_l}' y1='{y:.2f}' x2='{pad_l+plot_w}' y2='{y:.2f}' stroke='#eef2f6' />")
        parts.append(f"<text x='8' y='{y+5:.2f}' fill='#5a6776' font-size='14'>{v}</text>")
    for yr in x_ticks:
        x = sx(yr)
        parts.append(f"<line x1='{x:.2f}' y1='{pad_t}' x2='{x:.2f}' y2='{pad_t+plot_h}' stroke='#eef2f6' />")
        parts.append(f"<text x='{x-17:.2f}' y='{height-10}' fill='#5a6776' font-size='14'>{yr}</text>")
    parts.append(f"<text x='{width/2 - 40:.2f}' y='{height-6:.2f}' fill='#475467' font-size='15'>Year</text>")
    parts.append(f"<text x='14' y='20' fill='#475467' font-size='15'>Cumulative citations</text>")
    parts.append(f"<polyline fill='none' stroke='#2f6fb7' stroke-width='2.4' points='{poly}'/>")
    for x, y in series:
        parts.append(f"<circle cx='{sx(x):.2f}' cy='{sy(y):.2f}' r='2.4' fill='#2f6fb7' />")
    parts.append("</svg>")
    return "".join(parts)


def cumulative_chart_plotly(series):
    if not series:
        return "<p>No citation time-series data available.</p>"

    try:
        import plotly.graph_objects as go
    except Exception:
        return "<p>Plotly is unavailable for the cumulative citations chart.</p>"

    x_vals = [x for x, _ in series]
    y_vals = [y for _, y in series]
    current_year = dt.date.today().year
    is_ytd_segment = len(x_vals) >= 2 and x_vals[-1] == current_year and x_vals[-1] > x_vals[-2]

    fig = go.Figure()
    if is_ytd_segment:
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=x_vals[:-1],
                y=y_vals[:-1],
                mode="lines+markers",
                line=dict(color="#2f6fb7", width=2.5),
                marker=dict(color="#2f6fb7", size=6),
                hovertemplate="Year %{x}<br>Cumulative citations %{y}<extra></extra>",
            )
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=x_vals[-2:],
                y=y_vals[-2:],
                mode="lines",
                line=dict(color="#2f6fb7", width=2.5, dash="dash"),
                hovertemplate="Year %{x}<br>Cumulative citations %{y}<extra></extra>",
            )
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=[x_vals[-1]],
                y=[y_vals[-1]],
                mode="markers",
                marker=dict(symbol="circle-open", color="#2f6fb7", size=10, line=dict(color="#2f6fb7", width=2)),
                hovertemplate="Year %{x}<br>Cumulative citations %{y}<extra></extra>",
            )
        )
    else:
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=x_vals,
                y=y_vals,
                mode="lines+markers",
                line=dict(color="#2f6fb7", width=2.5),
                marker=dict(color="#2f6fb7", size=6),
                hovertemplate="Year %{x}<br>Cumulative citations %{y}<extra></extra>",
            )
        )
    fig.update_layout(
        height=360,
        margin={"l": 10, "r": 10, "t": 20, "b": 10},
        paper_bgcolor="#ffffff",
        plot_bgcolor="#ffffff",
        font=dict(size=14, color="#233447"),
        xaxis=dict(
            title="Year",
            title_font=dict(size=15),
            tickfont=dict(size=13),
            gridcolor="#eef2f6",
            zeroline=False,
        ),
        yaxis=dict(
            title="Cumulative citations",
            title_font=dict(size=15),
            tickfont=dict(size=13),
            gridcolor="#eef2f6",
            zeroline=False,
        ),
        annotations=(
            [
                dict(
                    x=x_vals[-1],
                    y=y_vals[-1],
                    text="(year to date)",
                    showarrow=False,
                    xanchor="left",
                    yanchor="bottom",
                    xshift=10,
                    yshift=8,
                    font=dict(size=12, color="#475467"),
                )
            ]
            if is_ytd_segment
            else []
        ),
        showlegend=False,
    )
    return fig.to_html(include_plotlyjs="cdn", full_html=False)


def word_cloud_svg(freq_items, width=980, height=420):
    if not freq_items:
        return "<p>No title-word data available.</p>"
    try:
        from wordcloud import STOPWORDS, WordCloud
    except Exception:
        STOPWORDS = set()
        WordCloud = None

    freq_map = {word: int(count) for word, count in freq_items if word}
    if not freq_map:
        return "<p>No title-word data available.</p>"

    stop_words = set(STOPWORDS)
    stop_words.update({"card", "lab", "labs", "work", "works", "paper", "papers", "study", "studies", "using", "based", "via", "analysis"})

    if WordCloud is None:
        # Lightweight deterministic fallback when the wordcloud package is unavailable.
        top = sorted(freq_map.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1], reverse=True)[:60]
        max_c = max(c for _, c in top) if top else 1
        cols = 6
        margin_x = 20
        margin_y = 24
        cell_w = max(120, int((width - 2 * margin_x) / cols))
        row_count = max(1, math.ceil(len(top) / cols))
        cell_h = max(26, int((height - 2 * margin_y) / row_count))
        random.seed(42)
        parts = [f"<svg viewBox='0 0 {width} {height}' width='100%' role='img' aria-label='Word cloud fallback from publication titles, abstracts, and keywords'>"]
        parts.append(f"<rect x='0' y='0' width='{width}' height='{height}' fill='white' />")
        for idx, (word, count) in enumerate(top):
            r = idx // cols
            c = idx % cols
            size = 12 + int(20 * (count / max_c))
            x = margin_x + c * cell_w + random.randint(4, 16)
            y = margin_y + r * cell_h + random.randint(16, max(18, cell_h - 4))
            color = "#2f6fb7" if idx < 12 else "#5b6e82"
            parts.append(f"<text x='{x}' y='{y}' font-size='{size}' fill='{color}'>{escape(word)}</text>")
        parts.append("</svg>")
        return "".join(parts)

    wc = WordCloud(
        width=1600,
        height=800,
        background_color="white",
        max_words=200,
        collocations=False,
        stopwords=stop_words,
        random_state=42,
    ).generate_from_frequencies(freq_map)

    image = wc.to_image()
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    image.save(buffer, format="PNG")
    encoded = base64.b64encode(buffer.getvalue()).decode("ascii")
    return (
        f"<img src='data:image/png;base64,{encoded}' "
        f"style='width:100%; height:auto; display:block;' "
        f"alt='Word cloud from publication titles, abstracts, and keywords' />"
    )


def build_pi_citation_csv_rows(pi_dois, cache_records=None):
    source_candidates = [Path("../files/references_citing_us.csv"), Path("files/references_citing_us.csv")]
    source = next((p for p in source_candidates if p.exists()), None)
    if not source:
        return [], None

    filtered_rows = []
    fieldnames = None
    with source.open("r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        fieldnames = reader.fieldnames or []
        for row in reader:
            ref_doi = normalize_doi(row.get("ref_doi") or "")
            if ref_doi and ref_doi in pi_dois:
                filtered_rows.append(row)

    filtered_rows = _backfill_citation_geo_rows(filtered_rows)

    target = Path("../files/references_citing_pi.csv")
    if not target.parent.exists():
        target = Path("files/references_citing_pi.csv")
    cache_records = cache_records if isinstance(cache_records, dict) else {}
    if fieldnames:
        cache_cols = [
            "row_type",
            "doi",
            "cited_by_count",
            "publication_year",
            "counts_by_year_json",
            "open_access_json",
            "best_oa_location_json",
            "updated_utc",
        ]
        out_fieldnames = list(fieldnames)
        for c in cache_cols:
            if c not in out_fieldnames:
                out_fieldnames.append(c)

        stamp = dt.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        cache_rows = []
        for doi in sorted(cache_records.keys()):
            rec = cache_records.get(doi) or {}
            cache_rows.append(
                {
                    "row_type": "cache",
                    "doi": doi,
                    "cited_by_count": int(rec.get("cited_by_count") or 0),
                    "publication_year": int(rec.get("publication_year") or 0) or "",
                    "counts_by_year_json": json.dumps(rec.get("counts_by_year") or [], ensure_ascii=False),
                    "open_access_json": json.dumps(rec.get("open_access") or {}, ensure_ascii=False),
                    "best_oa_location_json": json.dumps(rec.get("best_oa_location") or {}, ensure_ascii=False),
                    "updated_utc": stamp,
                }
            )

        map_rows = []
        for row in filtered_rows:
            out_row = dict(row)
            ref_doi = normalize_doi(out_row.get("ref_doi") or out_row.get("cited_doi") or "")
            rec = cache_records.get(ref_doi) if ref_doi else None
            out_row["row_type"] = "map"
            out_row["doi"] = ref_doi
            if rec:
                out_row["cited_by_count"] = int(rec.get("cited_by_count") or 0)
                out_row["publication_year"] = int(rec.get("publication_year") or 0) or ""
                out_row["counts_by_year_json"] = json.dumps(rec.get("counts_by_year") or [], ensure_ascii=False)
                out_row["open_access_json"] = json.dumps(rec.get("open_access") or {}, ensure_ascii=False)
                out_row["best_oa_location_json"] = json.dumps(rec.get("best_oa_location") or {}, ensure_ascii=False)
                out_row["updated_utc"] = stamp
            else:
                out_row["cited_by_count"] = ""
                out_row["publication_year"] = ""
                out_row["counts_by_year_json"] = ""
                out_row["open_access_json"] = ""
                out_row["best_oa_location_json"] = ""
                out_row["updated_utc"] = ""
            map_rows.append(out_row)

        with target.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=out_fieldnames)
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(map_rows + cache_rows)
    return filtered_rows, target


def _split_semicolon_values(value):
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return []
    return [part.strip() for part in text.split(";") if part.strip()]


def _search_openalex_institution_geo(affiliation_text, country_hint=None, cache=None):
    affiliation_text = str(affiliation_text or "").strip()
    if not affiliation_text:
        return None

    hint = str(country_hint or "").strip().upper()
    cache_key = (affiliation_text.lower(), hint)
    if cache is not None and cache_key in cache:
        return cache[cache_key]

    def _query(filter_value=None):
        params = {"search": affiliation_text, "per-page": 5}
        if filter_value:
            params["filter"] = filter_value
        url = "https://api.openalex.org/institutions?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params, quote_via=urllib.parse.quote)
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url,
            headers={"User-Agent": "CARD Lab scientometrics (mailto:paytonej@ucmail.uc.edu)"},
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=12) as resp:
            if resp.status != 200:
                return None
            return json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))

    payload = None
    try:
        payload = _query(f"country_code:{hint}") if hint else _query()
    except Exception:
        payload = None

    if not payload and hint:
        try:
            payload = _query()
        except Exception:
            payload = None

    result = None
    for inst in (payload or {}).get("results") or []:
        geo = inst.get("geo") or {}
        lat = geo.get("latitude")
        lon = geo.get("longitude")
        if lat is None or lon is None:
            continue
        result = (float(lat), float(lon), str(inst.get("display_name") or "").strip())
        break

    if cache is not None:
        cache[cache_key] = result
    return result


def _backfill_citation_geo_rows(rows):
    cache = {}
    output = []
    for row in rows:
        row = dict(row)
        try:
            lat_value = float(str(row.get("citing_latitude_mean") or "").strip())
            lon_value = float(str(row.get("citing_longitude_mean") or "").strip())
            has_geo = -90 <= lat_value <= 90 and -180 <= lon_value <= 180
        except Exception:
            has_geo = False
            lat_value = None
            lon_value = None

        if not has_geo:
            affiliations = _split_semicolon_values(row.get("citing_affiliations"))
            countries = _split_semicolon_values(row.get("citing_affiliation_countries"))
            resolved = []
            for index, affiliation in enumerate(affiliations):
                country_hint = countries[index] if index < len(countries) else (countries[0] if len(countries) == 1 else None)
                geo = _search_openalex_institution_geo(affiliation, country_hint=country_hint, cache=cache)
                if geo:
                    resolved.append(geo)
            if resolved:
                lat_value = sum(lat for lat, _, _ in resolved) / len(resolved)
                lon_value = sum(lon for _, lon, _ in resolved) / len(resolved)
                row["citing_latitude_mean"] = f"{lat_value:.6f}"
                row["citing_longitude_mean"] = f"{lon_value:.6f}"
        output.append(row)
    return output


def citation_map_svg(rows):
    citing_points = {}
    counts = Counter()
    for row in rows:
        citing_doi = normalize_doi(row.get("citing_doi") or "")
        if not citing_doi:
            continue
        try:
            lat = float(str(row.get("citing_latitude_mean") or "").strip())
            lon = float(str(row.get("citing_longitude_mean") or "").strip())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not (-90 <= lat <= 90 and -180 <= lon <= 180):
            continue
        # One marker contribution per citing paper; avoids overcount from multi-reference rows.
        citing_points[citing_doi] = (round(lat, 2), round(lon, 2))

    points = list(citing_points.values())
    for key in points:
        counts[key] += 1

    if not points:
        return "<p>No mappable latitude/longitude data found for PI citation references.</p>"

    try:
        import pandas as pd
        import plotly.express as px
    except Exception:
        return "<p>Plotly is unavailable for the PI citation map.</p>"

    df_map = pd.DataFrame(
        [{"latitude": lat, "longitude": lon, "count": count} for (lat, lon), count in counts.items()]
    )
    fig = px.scatter_geo(
        df_map,
        lat="latitude",
        lon="longitude",
        size="count",
        projection="natural earth",
        title="Affiliations of Papers Citing the PI's Works",
    )
    fig.update_traces(
        marker=dict(color="#2f80ed", line=dict(color="#1f5faf", width=0.8), opacity=0.42),
        hovertemplate="Lat %{lat:.2f}<br>Lon %{lon:.2f}<br>Citations %{marker.size}<extra></extra>",
    )
    fig.update_geos(
        showcountries=True,
        showcoastlines=True,
        showland=True,
        landcolor="#f3f6f9",
        oceancolor="#dceaf7",
        showocean=True,
        coastlinecolor="#9db4cc",
        countrycolor="#ffffff",
        projection_type="natural earth",
    )
    fig.update_layout(height=650, margin={"l": 0, "r": 0, "t": 60, "b": 0})
    return fig.to_html(include_plotlyjs="cdn", full_html=False)


zotero_raw = load_json_candidates(["../files/zotero-items.json", "files/zotero-items.json"])
pre_uc_raw = load_json_candidates(["../files/Pre-UC.json", "files/Pre-UC.json"])

zotero_items = [x for x in (zotero_raw or []) if isinstance(x, dict) and x.get("data")]
pre_uc_items = [normalize_pre_uc_item(x) for x in (pre_uc_raw or []) if isinstance(x, dict)]
merged_items = [
    x
    for x in dedupe_items(zotero_items + pre_uc_items)
    if has_payton_author(x)
    or (
        str((x.get("data") or {}).get("librarySource") or "").strip().lower() == "pre-uc"
        and is_presentation_record(x)
    )
]
pi_dois = {normalize_doi(x.get("data", {}).get("DOI") or "") for x in merged_items}
pi_dois = {x for x in pi_dois if x}

    for p in profiles
    if normalize_doi((p.get("_query_doi") or p.get("doi") or ""))
}
citation_counts = [int(p.get("cited_by_count") or 0) for p in profiles]

def top_cited_superset_rows(items, citation_by_doi, n=10):

    rows = []
    seen = set()
    for item in items:
        d = item.get("data") or {}
        doi = normalize_doi(d.get("DOI") or "")
        if not doi or doi in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(doi)
        rows.append(
            {
                "title": str(d.get("title") or "Untitled").strip(),
                "year": extract_year(d.get("date")),
                "doi": doi,
                "citations": int(citation_by_doi.get(doi, 0)),
            }
        )

    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["citations"], r["year"] or -1, r["title"].lower()), reverse=True)
    return rows[:n]


def render_top_cited_table(rows):
    if not rows:
        return "<p>No DOI-linked records available for a citation table.</p>"

    def _render_title_keep_braces_math(raw):
        text = str(raw or "")
        while True:
            dec = html.unescape(text)
            if dec == text:
                break
            text = dec
        while True:
            unwrapped = re.sub(r"\{([^{}]+)\}", r"\1", text)
            if unwrapped == text:
                break
            text = unwrapped
        token_re = re.compile(r"(\$[^$]+\$)")
        rendered = []
        pos = 0
        for m in token_re.finditer(text):
            if m.start() > pos:
                rendered.append(escape(text[pos:m.start()]))
            rendered.append(m.group(1))
            pos = m.end()
        if pos < len(text):
            rendered.append(escape(text[pos:]))
        return "".join(rendered)

    body = []
    for i, r in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        title = _render_title_keep_braces_math(r.get("title") or "Untitled")
        year = r.get("year")
        year_text = str(year) if isinstance(year, int) else ""
        citations = int(r.get("citations") or 0)
        doi = str(r.get("doi") or "")
        doi_link = f"<a href='https://doi.org/{escape(doi, quote=True)}' target='_blank'>doi:{escape(doi)}</a>" if doi else ""
        paper_with_doi = title + (f"<br><span class='top-cited-doi'>{doi_link}</span>" if doi_link else "")
        body.append(
            "<tr>"
            + f"<td>{i}</td>"
            + f"<td>{paper_with_doi}</td>"
            + f"<td>{escape(year_text)}</td>"
            + f"<td>{citations}</td>"
            + "</tr>"
        )

    return (
        "<div class='top-cited-wrap'><table class='top-cited-table'>"
        + "<colgroup><col class='col-rank'><col class='col-paper'><col class='col-year'><col class='col-cites'></colgroup>"
        + "<thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Paper</th><th>Year</th><th>Citations</th></tr></thead>"
        + "<tbody>"
        + "".join(body)
        + "</tbody></table></div>"
    )
```

```{python}
#| echo: false

from html import escape


def pub_creator_name(c):
    c = c if isinstance(c, dict) else {}
    if c.get("name"):
        return str(c.get("name")).strip()
    first = str(c.get("firstName") or "").strip()
    last = str(c.get("lastName") or "").strip()
    if first and last:
        initials = " ".join(f"{p[0].upper()}." for p in first.split() if p)
        return f"{initials} {last}".strip()
    return last or first


def pub_authors(creators):
    return ", ".join([x for x in (pub_creator_name(c) for c in (creators or [])) if x])


def pub_year(date_text):
    y = extract_year(date_text)
    return str(y) if y else ""


def format_display_date(date_text):
    parsed = parse_date(str(date_text or ""))
    if parsed:
        return f"{parsed.day} {parsed.strftime('%b %Y')}"
    return str(date_text or "").strip()


def render_text_with_sub_and_math(text):
    raw = str(text or "")
    while True:
        dec = html.unescape(raw)
        if dec == raw:
            break
        raw = dec
    # Curly braces from Zotero/CSL protect capitalization; keep text, drop braces.
    while True:
        unwrapped = re.sub(r"\{([^{}]+)\}", r"\1", raw)
        if unwrapped == raw:
            break
        raw = unwrapped
    if not raw:
        return ""
    token_re = re.compile(r"(<sub>.*?</sub>|<i>.*?</i>|\$[^$]+\$)", flags=re.I | re.S)
    rendered = []
    pos = 0
    for match in token_re.finditer(raw):
        if match.start() > pos:
            rendered.append(escape(raw[pos:match.start()]))
        token = match.group(0)
        if token.lower().startswith("<sub>"):
            inner = re.sub(r"^<sub>|</sub>$", "", token, flags=re.I)
            rendered.append(f"<sub>{escape(inner)}</sub>")
        elif token.lower().startswith("<i>"):
            inner = re.sub(r"^<i>|</i>$", "", token, flags=re.I)
            rendered.append(f"<span class='italic'>{escape(inner)}</span>")
        else:
            # Render simple sub/sup tokens directly; keep other math expressions in inline math delimiters.
            math_inner = token[1:-1]
            if re.fullmatch(r"_[^\s]+", math_inner):
                rendered.append(f"<sub>{escape(math_inner[1:])}</sub>")
            elif re.fullmatch(r"\^[^\s]+", math_inner):
                rendered.append(f"<sup>{escape(math_inner[1:])}</sup>")
            else:
                rendered.append(f"${math_inner}$")
        pos = match.end()
    if pos < len(raw):
        rendered.append(escape(raw[pos:]))
    return "".join(rendered)


def creator_name_initials(creator):
    creator = creator if isinstance(creator, dict) else {}
    first = str(creator.get("firstName") or "").strip()
    last = str(creator.get("lastName") or "").strip()
    if first and last:
        initials = " ".join(f"{part[0].upper()}." for part in first.split() if part)
        return f"{initials} {last}".strip()

    literal = str(creator.get("name") or "").strip()
    if not literal:
        return ""

    parts = literal.split()
    if len(parts) <= 1:
        return literal
    surname = parts[-1]
    initials = " ".join(f"{part[0].upper()}." for part in parts[:-1] if part)
    return f"{initials} {surname}".strip()


def publication_indicators(d):
    doi = normalize_doi(str(d.get("DOI") or "").strip())
    if not doi:
        return ""

    prof_map = globals().get("profile_by_doi") or {}
    profile = prof_map.get(doi) if isinstance(prof_map, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(profile, dict):
        return ""

    chips = []
    cited_by = int(profile.get("cited_by_count") or 0)
    chips.append(f"<span class='metric-chip'>Cited by {cited_by}</span>")

    open_access = profile.get("open_access") if isinstance(profile.get("open_access"), dict) else {}
    oa_url = str(open_access.get("oa_url") or "").strip()
    oa_status = str(open_access.get("oa_status") or "").strip().lower()
    if oa_url:
        oa_label = "Open Access"
        if oa_status:
            oa_label += f" ({oa_status})"
        chips.append(
            f"<a class='metric-chip oa-chip' href='{escape(oa_url, quote=True)}' target='_blank'>{escape(oa_label)}</a>"
        )

    pdf_url = ""
    best_oa_location = profile.get("best_oa_location") if isinstance(profile.get("best_oa_location"), dict) else {}
    if isinstance(best_oa_location, dict):
        pdf_url = str(best_oa_location.get("pdf_url") or "").strip()
    if not pdf_url and oa_url.lower().split("?", 1)[0].endswith(".pdf"):
        pdf_url = oa_url
    if pdf_url:
        chips.append(
            f"<a class='metric-chip pdf-chip' href='{escape(pdf_url, quote=True)}' target='_blank'>PDF</a>"
        )

    return (" " + " ".join(chips)) if chips else ""


def pub_citation(item, idx, total):
    d = item.get("data") or {}
    creators = d.get("creators") or []
    authors = [c for c in creators if c.get("creatorType") == "author"]
    editors = [c for c in creators if c.get("creatorType") == "editor"]
    presenters = [c for c in creators if c.get("creatorType") == "presenter"]
    main = creators if d.get("itemType") in ("computerProgram", "presentation") else authors
    names = pub_authors(main) or "Unknown author"
    title = render_text_with_sub_and_math(d.get("title") or "Untitled")
    year = pub_year(d.get("date"))
    journal = str(d.get("publicationTitle") or d.get("proceedingsTitle") or "").strip()
    proceedings = str(d.get("proceedingsTitle") or "").strip()
    meeting = str(d.get("meetingName") or "").strip()
    place = str(d.get("place") or "").strip()
    publisher = str(d.get("publisher") or "").strip()
    institution = str(d.get("institution") or "").strip()
    report_number = str(d.get("reportNumber") or "").strip()
    report_type = str(d.get("reportType") or "").strip()
    series_title = str(d.get("seriesTitle") or "").strip()
    presentation_type = str(d.get("presentationType") or "").strip()
    full_date = str(d.get("date") or "").strip()
    volume = str(d.get("volume") or "").strip()
    issue = str(d.get("issue") or "").strip()
    pages = str(d.get("pages") or "").strip()
    doi = normalize_doi(str(d.get("DOI") or "").strip())
    url = str(d.get("url") or "").strip()

    bits = [f"[{total - idx}] {escape(names)}. \"{title}.\""]
    if d.get("itemType") == "conferencePaper" and proceedings:
        bits.append(f"In <span class='italic'>{render_text_with_sub_and_math(proceedings)}</span>")
        if editors:
            bits.append(f"{escape(pub_authors(editors))} ({'ed.' if len(editors)==1 else 'eds.'})")
        if publisher:
            bits.append(f"Published by {escape(publisher)}")
        if place:
            bits.append(escape(place))
    if d.get("itemType") == "report":
        if report_type:
            bits.append(escape(report_type))
        if report_number:
            bits.append(f"No. {escape(report_number)}")
        if series_title:
            bits.append(f"<span class='italic'>{escape(series_title)}</span>")
        if institution:
            bits.append(escape(institution))
        if editors:
            bits.append(f"Edited by {escape(pub_authors(editors))}")
        if publisher:
            bits.append(f"Published by {escape(publisher)}")
        if place:
            bits.append(escape(place))
    if d.get("itemType") == "presentation":
        if presentation_type:
            bits.append(escape(presentation_type))
        if meeting:
            bits.append(f"at <span class='italic'>{render_text_with_sub_and_math(meeting)}</span>")
        if place:
            bits.append(escape(place))
        if full_date:
            bits.append(escape(full_date))
    if journal:
        bits.append(f"<span class='italic'>{render_text_with_sub_and_math(journal)}</span>")
    if d.get("itemType") == "magazineArticle" and publisher:
        bits.append(f"Published by {escape(publisher)}")
    if d.get("itemType") == "magazineArticle" and editors:
        bits.append(f"Edited by {escape(pub_authors(editors))}")
    if volume:
        bits.append(f"<span class='bold'>{escape(volume)}</span>")
    if issue:
        bits.append(f"({escape(issue)})")
    if year:
        bits.append(f"({escape(year)})")
    if pages:
        bits.append(f"p.{escape(pages)}")
    if doi:
        bits.append(f"<a href='https://doi.org/{escape(doi, quote=True)}' target='_blank'>doi:{escape(doi)}</a>")
    include_url = (not doi) or str(d.get("itemType") or "") != "journalArticle"
    if include_url and url and (not doi or normalize_doi(url) != doi):
        bits.append(f"<a href='{escape(url, quote=True)}' target='_blank'>{escape(url)}</a>")

    text = " ".join([b for b in bits if b]).strip()
    if not text.endswith("."):
        text += "."
    doi_attr = f" data-doi='{escape(doi, quote=True)}'" if doi else ""
    return f"<div class='citation'{doi_attr}>{text}</div>"


def _creator_is_payton(creator):
    last = str(creator.get("lastName") or "").strip().lower()
    full = creator_name(creator).lower()
    return last == "payton" or re.search(r"\bpayton\b", full)


def presentation_creator_text(creators, use_initials=False):
    rendered = []
    for creator in creators or []:
        name = creator_name_initials(creator) if use_initials else creator_name(creator)
        if not name:
            continue
        safe_name = escape(name)
        creator_type = str(creator.get("creatorType") or "").strip().lower()
        if creator_type == "presenter":
            rendered.append(f"<em>{safe_name}</em> (presenter)")
        else:
            rendered.append(safe_name)
    return ", ".join(rendered) if rendered else "Unknown author"


def presentation_role(item):
    creators = item.get("data", {}).get("creators") or []
    for creator in creators:
        if _creator_is_payton(creator):
            return str(creator.get("creatorType") or "").strip().lower()
    return None


def presentation_citation(item, idx, total, use_initials=False):
    d = item.get("data") or {}
    creators = d.get("creators") or []
    title = render_text_with_sub_and_math(d.get("title") or "Untitled")
    meeting = str(d.get("meetingName") or d.get("proceedingsTitle") or "").strip()
    place = str(d.get("place") or "").strip()
    presentation_type = str(d.get("presentationType") or "").strip()
    full_date = format_display_date(d.get("date"))
    url = str(d.get("url") or "").strip()

    bits = [f"[{total - idx}] {presentation_creator_text(creators, use_initials=use_initials)}. \"{title}.\""]
    if presentation_type:
        bits.append(escape(presentation_type))
    if meeting:
        bits.append(f"at <span class='italic'>{render_text_with_sub_and_math(meeting)}</span>")
    if place and full_date:
        bits.append(f"{escape(place)}, {escape(full_date)}")
    elif place:
        bits.append(escape(place))
    elif full_date:
        bits.append(escape(full_date))
    if url:
        bits.append(f"<a href='{escape(url, quote=True)}' target='_blank'>{escape(url)}</a>")

    text = " ".join([b for b in bits if b]).strip()
    if not text.endswith("."):
        text += "."
    return f"<div class='citation'>{text}</div>"


def is_software_dataset(item):
    d = item.get("data") or {}
    item_type = str(d.get("itemType") or "").strip().lower()
    title = str(d.get("title") or "").lower()
    pub_title = str(d.get("publicationTitle") or "").lower()
    extra = str(d.get("extra") or "").lower()
    if item_type in {"computerprogram", "dataset"}:
        return True
    if "software" in title or "dataset" in title or "software" in extra or "dataset" in extra:
        return True
    if "data in brief" in pub_title or "dataset" in pub_title:
        return True
    return False


def is_manuscript(item):
    d = item.get("data") or {}
    item_type = str(d.get("itemType") or "").strip().lower()
    title = str(d.get("title") or "").lower()
    pub_title = str(d.get("publicationTitle") or "").lower()
    extra = str(d.get("extra") or "").lower()
    if item_type == "manuscript":
        return True
    return any("manuscript" in text for text in (title, pub_title, extra))


def pub_sort_key(item):
    d = item.get("data") or {}
    date_value = parse_date(d.get("date"))
    if date_value is None:
        return (dt.date.min, str(d.get("title") or "").lower())
    return (date_value, str(d.get("title") or "").lower())


peer_reviewed = []
reports_conf_mag = []
software_datasets = []
presentations_given = []
presentation_contributions = []

for item in merged_items:
    d = item.get("data") or {}
    item_type = str(d.get("itemType") or "")
    is_presentation_entry = is_presentation_record(item)
    if is_presentation_entry:
        if presentation_role(item) == "presenter":
            presentations_given.append(item)
        else:
            presentation_contributions.append(item)
        continue
    if is_manuscript(item):
        continue
    elif is_software_dataset(item):
        software_datasets.append(item)
    elif item_type == "journalArticle":
        peer_reviewed.append(item)
    elif item_type == "presentation":
        continue
    else:
        reports_conf_mag.append(item)

peer_reviewed = sorted(peer_reviewed, key=pub_sort_key, reverse=True)
reports_conf_mag = sorted(reports_conf_mag, key=pub_sort_key, reverse=True)
software_datasets = sorted(software_datasets, key=pub_sort_key, reverse=True)
presentations_given = sorted(presentations_given, key=pub_sort_key, reverse=True)
presentation_contributions = sorted(presentation_contributions, key=pub_sort_key, reverse=True)


def render_pub_section(title, items):
    if not items:
        return f"<h3>{escape(title)}</h3><p>No entries found.</p>"
    lines = "".join(pub_citation(item, i, len(items)) for i, item in enumerate(items))
    return f"<h3>{escape(title)}</h3><div class='pub-list'>{lines}</div>"


def render_presentation_section(title, items):
    if not items:
        return f"<h3>{escape(title)}</h3><p>No entries found.</p>"
    use_initials = title.strip().lower() in {"presentation contributions", "presentations given"}
    lines = "".join(presentation_citation(item, i, len(items), use_initials=use_initials) for i, item in enumerate(items))
    return f"<h3>{escape(title)}</h3><div class='pub-list'>{lines}</div>"


display(
    HTML(
        """
<style>
  #pi-publications-final { margin-top: 0.25rem; }
  #pi-publications-final h3 { margin-top: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 0.55rem; }
    #pi-publications-final .citation { margin-bottom: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.35; overflow-wrap: anywhere; word-break: break-word; }
  #pi-publications-final .italic { font-style: italic; }
  #pi-publications-final .bold { font-weight: 700; }
    #pi-publications-final .oa-icon {
        margin-left: 6px;
        vertical-align: middle;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
    }
    #pi-publications-final .oa-gold { color: #FFD700; }
    #pi-publications-final .oa-green { color: #2e7d32; }
    #pi-publications-final .oa-bronze { color: #cd7f32; }
    #pi-publications-final .oa-hybrid { color: #ff8f00; }
    #pi-publications-final .oa-diamond { color: #b9f2ff; }
    #pi-publications-final .oa-unknown { color: #1e88e5; }
    #pi-publications-final .pdf-icon {
        margin-left: 4px;
        color: #e00122;
        vertical-align: middle;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
    }
</style>
<script type='text/javascript' src='//d1bxh8uas1mnw7.cloudfront.net/assets/embed.js'></script>
<script async src='https://badge.dimensions.ai/badge.js' charset='utf-8'></script>
<script src='https://code.iconify.design/2/2.2.1/iconify.min.js'></script>
<script>
    function oaColorClass(status) {
        switch ((status || '').toLowerCase()) {
            case 'gold': return 'oa-gold';
            case 'green': return 'oa-green';
            case 'bronze': return 'oa-bronze';
            case 'hybrid': return 'oa-hybrid';
            case 'diamond': return 'oa-diamond';
            default: return 'oa-unknown';
        }
    }

    (async function injectPiPublicationBadges() {
        function addBaseBadges(citationEl, doi) {
            if (!citationEl.querySelector('.altmetric-embed')) {
                const altmetricBadge = document.createElement('span');
                altmetricBadge.className = 'altmetric-embed';
                altmetricBadge.setAttribute('data-badge-type', '4');
                altmetricBadge.setAttribute('data-doi', doi);
                altmetricBadge.setAttribute('data-hide-no-mentions', 'true');
                altmetricBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
                altmetricBadge.style.marginLeft = '6px';
                citationEl.appendChild(altmetricBadge);
            }

            if (!citationEl.querySelector('.__dimensions_badge_embed__')) {
                const dimensionsBadge = document.createElement('span');
                dimensionsBadge.className = '__dimensions_badge_embed__';
                dimensionsBadge.setAttribute('data-style', 'small_rectangle');
                dimensionsBadge.setAttribute('data-doi', doi);
                dimensionsBadge.setAttribute('data-hide-zero-citations', 'true');
                dimensionsBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
                dimensionsBadge.style.marginLeft = '6px';
                citationEl.appendChild(dimensionsBadge);
            }
        }

        let container = document.getElementById('pi-publications-final');
        for (let i = 0; i < 20 && !container; i++) {
            await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
            container = document.getElementById('pi-publications-final');
        }
        if (!container) return;

        const citationEls = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.citation[data-doi]'));
        if (citationEls.length === 0) return;

        const doiToElements = {};
        citationEls.forEach((el) => {
            const doi = (el.getAttribute('data-doi') || '').toLowerCase();
            if (!doi) return;
            if (!doiToElements[doi]) doiToElements[doi] = [];
            doiToElements[doi].push(el);
            addBaseBadges(el, doi);
        });

        if (typeof _altmetric_embed_init === 'function') _altmetric_embed_init();
        if (window.__dimensions_embed?.addBadges) window.__dimensions_embed.addBadges();

        const dois = Object.keys(doiToElements);
        const chunkSize = 100;
        const chunks = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < dois.length; i += chunkSize) chunks.push(dois.slice(i, i + chunkSize));

        const works = [];
        let openalexUnavailable = false;
        for (const chunk of chunks) {
            if (openalexUnavailable) break;
            const params = new URLSearchParams();
            params.set('filter', `doi:${chunk.join('|')}`);
            params.set('mailto', 'paytonej@ucmail.uc.edu');
            params.set('per-page', String(chunk.length));
            const apiUrl = `https://api.openalex.org/works?${params.toString()}`;
            try {
                const response = await fetch(apiUrl);
                const payload = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok) {
                    const message = String(payload?.message || payload?.error || '').toLowerCase();
                    if (message.includes('insufficient budget') || message.includes('dailyremainingusd')) {
                        openalexUnavailable = true;
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                works.push(...(payload.results || []));
            } catch (_) {
                continue;
            }
        }

        works.forEach((work) => {
            const doi = String(work.doi || '').replace(/^https?:\/\/doi.org\//i, '').toLowerCase();
            const targets = doiToElements[doi] || [];
            if (!targets.length) return;

            targets.forEach((citationEl) => {
                if (work.open_access?.is_oa && work.open_access.oa_url) {
                    const oaUrl = work.open_access.oa_url;
                    const oaStatus = work.open_access.oa_status || 'unknown';

                    const oaLink = document.createElement('a');
                    oaLink.href = oaUrl;
                    oaLink.target = '_blank';
                    oaLink.className = 'oa-icon-link oa-icon ' + oaColorClass(oaStatus);

                    const oaIcon = document.createElement('span');
                    oaIcon.className = 'iconify';
                    oaIcon.setAttribute('data-icon', 'academicons:open-access');
                    oaIcon.setAttribute('data-width', '20');
                    oaIcon.setAttribute('data-height', '20');
                    oaLink.appendChild(oaIcon);
                    citationEl.appendChild(oaLink);

                    const oaUrls = work.open_access?.oa_urls || [];
                    const pdfRegex = /\.pdf(\?|$)/i;
                    let pdfUrl = null;
                    const pdfEntry = oaUrls.find(entry => pdfRegex.test(entry.url));
                    if (pdfEntry) pdfUrl = pdfEntry.url;
                    if (!pdfUrl && pdfRegex.test(oaUrl)) pdfUrl = oaUrl;
                    if (pdfUrl) {
                        const pdfLink = document.createElement('a');
                        pdfLink.href = pdfUrl;
                        pdfLink.target = '_blank';
                        pdfLink.className = 'pdf-icon-link pdf-icon';

                        const pdfIcon = document.createElement('span');
                        pdfIcon.className = 'iconify';
                        pdfIcon.setAttribute('data-icon', 'mdi:file-pdf-box');
                        pdfIcon.setAttribute('data-width', '20');
                        pdfIcon.setAttribute('data-height', '20');
                        pdfLink.appendChild(pdfIcon);
                        citationEl.appendChild(pdfLink);
                    }
                }
            });
        });

        if (window.Iconify?.scan) window.Iconify.scan();
    })();
</script>
"""
    )
)

        + render_presentation_section("Presentations Given", presentations_given)
        + render_presentation_section("Presentation Contributions", presentation_contributions)
        + "</div>"
    )
)
```
